factors.name: energy_level
factors.description: Was a high-energy source present (height, pressure, electrical, mechanical, vehicle, gravity)?

scoring_guide.1: Moderate energy present but controlled or low-magnitude
scoring_guide.2: High-magnitude energy present (height >2m, high pressure, high voltage, heavy suspended load, moving vehicle)

factors.name: barrier_failure
factors.description: Did a critical safety barrier/control fail, or was one absent (PPE, isolation, permit, guard, procedure)?

scoring_guide.0: All relevant barriers were in place and functioning
scoring_guide.1: A barrier was degraded, late, or partially bypassed
scoring_guide.2: A critical barrier was fully absent, defeated, or bypassed

factors.name: human_proximity
factors.description: Was a person in the direct exposure/impact path of the hazard?

scoring_guide.0: No person in the exposure path
scoring_guide.1: Person was near but not directly in the exposure path
scoring_guide.2: Person was directly in the line of fire / exposure path

factors.name: exposure_duration
factors.description: Was the exposure momentary or prolonged?

scoring: Each factor is scored 0-2. Total is out of 8. A total score of 7 or higher classifies the report as high SIF-potential (sif_potential = true). Threshold was raised from 6 to 7 after the first labeling pass over-flagged 74% of reports against the ~20-25% published industry baseline.
